scenario: influencer landing premium Growth Form and native meeting CTA
reviewer: Codex — live visual and interaction review at 1536, 1440, 890 and 390 px

evidence.functional: Growth Form mounted with seven groups; empty-submit validation remained local; Growth CTA opened the native discovery scheduler dialog with zero HubSpot links and no booking.

hierarchy.rationale: Eyebrow, title, context, trust, fields and full-width submit read in one clear sequence.

proportions.rationale: The single 28 px paper balances the sticky editorial intro and reduces to 22 px on mobile.
proportions.evidence: desktop, tablet and mobile conversion captures

rhythm.rationale: Redundant paired-field helpers were removed; labels, 56 px controls and section breaks now keep a symmetric cadence.

density.rationale: Seven governed groups remain intentionally long, but the open layout and concise help maintain scanability.
density.nextAction: Any further shortening must be tested as a new governed Growth Form version; do not hide required operational fields with CSS or convert this host into a local wizard.

depth.rationale: One principal paper, restrained elevation and one justified legal sub-surface avoid nested-card noise.

surfaceEconomy.rationale: The form uses one surface; the native meeting CTA is a separate governed alternative, not another local accordion.

visualImpact.rationale: A thin blue-to-green signature, restrained tint and spotlight meeting CTA create identity without spectacle.

typography.rationale: Poppins is limited to the editorial heading; Geist carries controls at a legible 16 px minimum.

color.rationale: Neutral fields, blue functional states and supporting green accents preserve clear contrast and meaning.

iconography.rationale: Six semantic line icons, trust symbols and select chevrons use one visual language without decorative disks.

responsive.rationale: Pairs become one column, actions remain full-width where needed and every tested viewport has zero page overflow.

motion.rationale: Focus, hover and lift are causal; reduced motion reaches the same complete state.

fidelity.rationale: The approved Claude Design composition and conversion hierarchy remain while governed form and meeting primitives replace local approximations.

genericTemplateResistance.rationale: Editorial chrome, creator-specific cues and the native meeting task surface avoid a generic contact-form treatment.
